crossRefs.note: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause…
On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted…
Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall…
A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence…
I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of…
I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to…
They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to…
Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt; so that you will…
Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”
translations.bsb: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid Myself of the constant grumbling of the Israelites against you.”
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you.
